title: Iron Chain leaf — base envelope
description: Every leaf, in every domain, is this. A profile adds the fields its trade needs and nothing else. The protocol never learns what is being proved: it carries a subject, a window, a set of signals and a digest of whatever happened. See spec/leaf.md and spec/profiles.md.

schema.description: The profile this leaf follows, `family/name/vN`. A change to any field is a new version, never an edit.

subject.description: The key the fact belongs to. The same key signs this leaf. It is the only identity the protocol has — who it belongs to is never written.

window.description: When it happened, in UTC seconds. end > start. A profile may cap the span; the base does not.

signals.description: The signals this leaf actually has — see spec/signals.md. D is always there. No score and no level: a reader derives its own.

payloadHash.description: SHA-256 of the off-chain payload — the detail of what happened, in whatever shape the profile defines. The payload itself never leaves the subject unless they show it.

photoHashes.description: SHA-256 of the capture at the start of the window and at its end, taken in-app. Required with B. It does not prove what happened between them — it proves the window was inhabited.

kind.description: What produced the numbers. `terminal` covers a fixed reader — a time clock, a badge post.

baselineDays.description: How many days of history this device had on this subject when the window opened. A week-old device proves less than a year-old one, and C cannot be computed without a baseline.

device.description: The instrument behind M and C. Required with either.

role.description: `witness` — a human who was present, no accreditation required. `notarized` — a human whose accreditation the issuer verified, and who stakes it. The protocol names the role; the app names the trade.

signature.description:
Ed25519 signature of the cosigner over the printable text "Iron Chain
Witness this <noun>
<schema>
payload <payloadHash hex>" (UTF-8), see spec/leaf.md.

meta.description: Free, per issuer. Never identifying, never medical, never anything a reader could use to find the person behind the key.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature of the subject over the signing message built from the leaf hash. See spec/leaf.md.
